messages:
Ana - Marketing Lead: Need a compact field brief (one-pager PDF + email snippet) to hand AEs after the compliance webinar. Focus: security posture, SLA highlights, and which deployment to recommend. Draft by end of day Tue.

Liam - Content: I can draft. Proposed micro-headline: 'Enterprise-ready inference: secure, SLA-backed, deployable where you need it.' Keep it scannable with 3 bullets and a short discovery checklist.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll provide a deployment decision matrix: when to pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (VPC/on-prem). Include short tech notes: KMS + HSM, audit logs, network peering, and certs. I'll add a latency vs cost note for common configs.

Priya - Sales Ops: Routing rules we want encoded: ARR >= 200k OR compliance=HIPAA|FedRAMP|GDPR OR residency=required OR p95 target <120ms -> route to AE. Else SDR nurture. Also need subject line suggestions and a one-click CTA.

Zoe - AE: For field use, give a one-slide summary AEs can drop into a deck and a tiny FAQ for compliance questions (SOC2 scope, data retention, BYOK).

Sam - Growth: Add a short benchmark blurb for the brief: something like 'Redwood Dedicated reduces unit cost and improves p50 throughput for long-context workloads' with percent numbers if available. I'll hand numbers tomorrow morning.

Liam - Content: Draft email body (short): 'Thanks for joining our webinar. Attached is a one-page brief showing how Redwood supports secure, SLA-backed inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. If security, latency, or residency are top concerns, reply with that constraint and we'll connect you to the right teammate.' Suggested subject: 'Quick brief: SLAs, security, and private deployment for LLM inference'.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: Discovery checklist for SEs (copy/paste): '1) Data residency required? 2) Compliance framework (HIPAA/SOC2/FedRAMP)? 3) Expected QPS and p95 latency target? 4) Typical context length (tokens)? 5) Monthly token volume? 6) Preferred deployment?'.

Priya - Sales Ops: Here's a JSON snippet for our inbound tagging system to include in the brief so ops can paste it into the webhook:```json
{"conditions":"ARR>=200000|compliance:HIPAA,FEDRAMP,GDPR|residency=required|latency_p95<120","route":"AE-enterprise","priority":100}
```

Liam - Content: Plan for the one-pager layout: top-line value prop (1 sentence), 3 bullets (SLA, security, deployment control), quick case blurbs (fintech / health / search), mini-checklist, routing snippet, and CTA. Keep it printable.

Sam - Growth: For webinar follow-up funnel, recommend: email -> brief -> short form that collects sensitive constraints and auto-tags -> SDR sequence (if not AE). We'll include the form link in the one-pager footer.

Zoe - AE: Add 2 quick objection answers: 'How do you isolate customer models/data?' and 'What happens during a rollout?'. Two-sentence answers max.

Ravi - Solutions Eng: Rollout answer: canary by traffic and automatic fallback to hosted variant; pin model versions; audit logs for requests. Isolation answer: Dedicated pools and VPC options, PKI + KMS integration, and disk-level encryption.

deploy-bot: Created ticket MKT-4920: 'Field one-pager & AE slide for webinar follow-up' assigned to Liam. Due in 48 hours.

Priya - Sales Ops: I'll update SDR playbook and create rule in inbound system after asset publishes. ETA Friday EOD.

Ana - Marketing Lead: Owners: Liam (copy + PDF + email snippet), Ravi (matrix + FAQ + checklist), Priya (routing JSON + play updates), Zoe (AE slide content), Sam (bench numbers). Callout: make the PDF field-friendly (no tiny fonts).

Liam - Content: Will circulate draft by Mon noon for rapid review.

Sam - Growth: Will post benchmark numbers by Mon 9am.

Ana - Marketing Lead: Thanks everyone. We'll use this as the canonical webinar follow-up for the next 45 days. Closing thread. :checkered_flag:
